question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure a QoS policy that controls only vHBA traffic. Which policy must be used to meet this requirement?
context: UCS Manager GUI: LAN / LAN Cloud / QoS System Class. Table with Priority, Enabled, Cos, Packet Drop, Weight, Weight (MB), MTU, Multicast Optimized columns for rows: Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze, Best Effort, Fibre Channel.
theory: Cisco UCS's unified fabric maintains a dedicated 'Fibre Channel' QoS system class, separate from the Ethernet classes (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze, Best Effort), specifically to carry FCoE-encapsulated Fibre Channel traffic from vHBAs with lossless, no-drop handling appropriate for storage protocols. To control QoS behavior for vHBA traffic only — without affecting Ethernet/vNIC traffic — the Fibre Channel system class is the one that must be configured, since the Ethernet-named classes govern LAN traffic instead. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Network Management, QoS System Classes)
